name: parcel-toolkit-royal-mail
displayName: Parcel Toolkit for Royal Mail Click & Drop
description: Book, track and cancel Royal Mail and Parcelforce shipments by asking Claude. It uses your own Click & Drop account, runs on your computer and talks straight to Royal Mail.
